stem: Which set of measurements best matches the neonatal 50th percentiles?

options.text: Birth weight 2.5 kg, head circumference 32 cm, length 48 cm
Birth weight 3.0 kg, head circumference 34 cm, length 50 cm
Birth weight 3.5 kg, head circumference 35 cm, length 53 cm
Birth weight 4.0 kg, head circumference 36 cm, length 55 cm
Birth weight 4.5 kg, head circumference 38 cm, length 58 cm

explanation: Birth weight 3.5 kg, head circumference 35 cm, and length 53 cm are the neonatal 50th percentile measurements.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because these values do not match the neonatal 50th percentile measurements.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because these values are below the neonatal 50th percentile measurements.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because birth weight 3.5 kg, head circumference 35 cm, and length 53 cm are the neonatal 50th percentile measurements.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because these values are above the neonatal 50th percentile measurements.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because these values are well above the neonatal 50th percentile measurements.
